name: Photo Forces
doc: The brightest spots in the picture lift magnetic needles or form gravity wells that pull dust coloured by the picture. Bass strengthens both forces and phrase boundaries let the picture settle.

in.doc: colour of the surface, needles and dust

height.doc: brightness locates wells and raises peaks

flow.doc: picture contours steer the dust and refract the surface

drive.doc: how hard bass and percussion drive the forces
